exposure: Novel de novo heterozygous synonymous variant c.1029G>A, p.Ala343Ala in FGFR1
Novel de novo heterozygous missense variant c.1868A>G, p.(Asp623Gly) in FGFR1
outcome: Hartsfield syndrome (holoprosencephaly, ectrodactyly, cleft lip/palate, developmental delay, isolated hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, central diabetes insipidus, vertebral anomalies, eye anomalies, cardiac malformations)
cohort: Three patients with Hartsfield syndrome from two unrelated families were studied.
finding: The study identified novel de novo heterozygous synonymous and missense variants in the FGFR1 gene associated with Hartsfield syndrome.
